meaning:
κτίστης, -oυ, ὁ
(κτίζω), [in LXX: 2Ki.22:32 (Heb., al.), Jdth.9:12, Sir.24:8, 2 24:1-34; 4Ma.5:1-38 * ;]
1. (cl.) a founder.
2. a creator: of God, 1Pe.4:19.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Therefore let them also who suffer according to the will of God in doing good entrust their souls to him, as to a faithful Creator.
